companyFieldUpdates.name: Generate–Stem LCR
companyFieldUpdates.description: Generate-Stem LCR, LLC is a Delaware special-purpose vehicle formed on June 30, 2017 to purchase and own behind-the-meter battery-storage systems supporting Southern California Edison's West Los Angeles Basin local-capacity program. Stem, Inc. holds a 50% Class B non-managing interest and remains the host-facing technology and operating counterparty. Stem's filings describe a two-class structure and its 50% interest, so the Generate-linked Class A managing interest is recorded as an inferred 50%; the exact Generate affiliate and fund are not publicly disclosed. The cited 85 MW / 340 MWh figures are contract and funding ceilings rather than verified deployed capacity. Stem continued to report obligations and repayments for its consolidated SPE program through June 30, 2026, and no sale, transfer, foreclosure, dissolution or signed pending ownership transaction for Generate-Stem LCR was identified through August 29, 2026.
